cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm extending your tea visit. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've had three cups. Can I stop drinking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Your new assignment is to hear me practise before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I authorize a two-minute delay. Let me get through 'I'll be in hospital' once, with you here. If I can say it steadily, I'll call them in after you go.

reason: A grants release from tea but assigns rehearsal support, with B taxi causing a finite one-sentence steadiness test before facing the children alone.
